p: The Abu Dhabi Healthcare Information and Cyber Security (ADHICS) standard is a mandatory framework established by the Department of Health – Abu Dhabi (DoH) to protect patient data and enhance cybersecurity. It applies to all licensed healthcare entities in Abu Dhabi, enforcing strict, 11-domain compliance to safeguard health information, ensuring confidentiality, integrity, and availability.+3 Key Aspects of Abu Dhabi Health Sector Information Security:

: All healthcare facilities—hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies—must comply with ADHICS regulations, which are designed to protect against cyber threats and ensure secure data handling, particularly within the Malaffi health information exchange.
The framework mandates information security governance, risk management, access control, data protection (encryption at rest/transit), incident response, and physical security.
: The Department of Health oversees these initiatives through the AAMEN programme, which evaluates facilities against international security standards.
Malaffi uses advanced security protocols, including encryption and strict access controls for authorized healthcare professionals.
Access Management: Strict governance ensures only authorized personnel access patient records.
: Implementation of encryption for all sensitive health data.
Regular risk assessments and incident response planning are required.
